How I Work

Engineering habits

Principles I use across coursework, team delivery, and independent products.

01

Start with boundaries

Clarify ownership, permissions, state transitions, and failure modes before choosing interfaces or implementation details.

02

Validate with evidence

Use tests, execution traces, explicit state changes, and reproducible results—not only a successful demo path.

03

Design for collaboration

Make systems understandable through documentation, reproducible setup, and honest attribution of individual contributions.
